title: Profile
description: The contents of a Profile's `profile.json`: a named Load order together with the list of enabled Mods.

active_plugins.description: The Plugins that are active, in Load order.

load_order.description: All Plugin file names in Load order, later wins.

mods.description: The Mods in priority order, highest first, as in MO2's `modlist.txt` (the first Mod wins a file conflict).

name.description: The Profile's name, which is also its folder name.

schema_version.description: Version of this file's layout; see [`PROFILE_SCHEMA_VERSION`].

ProfileMod.description: One Mod in a Profile's list.

enabled.description: Whether the Mod is enabled in this Profile.

name.description: The Mod's folder name in the Instance.
